biggest_catch: The referred friend must remain on supply with Utilita for at least 60 days before either reward is issued — and the friend gets a £50 Amazon gift card, not energy credit, so only your £50 meter credit counts as savings on planned energy spending.
catches: You must be a domestic Utilita customer with an active Smart account and a working smart meter to refer.
The friend must be a new domestic Utilita customer on supply for at least 60 days.
Rewards are issued only after the friend reaches the 60-day milestone.
Your reward is £50 credit on your electricity meter (savings on planned spending); the friend's £50 Amazon gift card is not an energy saving.
Each referral link can be used by one friend only and expires after 72 hours if unused; max three active links at a time.
UK Pay As You Go energy only; confirm the program is still current before sharing.

steps: As an existing Utilita customer with a working smart meter, generate a referral link in the My Utilita app.
Share the link with a friend (text, email, WhatsApp, social).
The friend uses your link to complete the switch to Utilita.
Once the friend has been on supply for 60 days, £50 credit is applied to your electricity meter.
timing: Rewards are issued automatically once the friend reaches the 60-day supply milestone.
